// BEGIN src/waves.js
// One immutable wave model drives both CPU samples and the vertex shader.
window.HUNTER_WAVES=(()=>{
  const components=Object.freeze([
    Object.freeze({kind:'sin',x:.03,z:0,speed:1.2,amplitude:.9}),
    Object.freeze({kind:'cos',x:0,z:.04,speed:.9,amplitude:.9}),
    Object.freeze({kind:'sin',x:.07,z:.07,speed:2,amplitude:.4})
  ]);
  const shore=Object.freeze({offset:.6,depth:9,min:.12,max:1});
  const amplitude=bed=>Math.max(shore.min,Math.min(shore.max,(-bed+shore.offset)/shore.depth));
  const height=(x,z,time,bed)=>components.reduce((sum,w)=>sum+Math[w.kind](x*w.x+z*w.z+time*w.speed)*w.amplitude,0)*amplitude(bed);
  const gl=n=>Number.isInteger(n)?n+'.0':String(n);
  const expression=components.map(w=>`${w.kind}(p.x*${gl(w.x)}+p.y*${gl(w.z)}+time*${gl(w.speed)})*${gl(w.amplitude)}`).join('+');
  const glsl=`float hunterWaveHeight(vec2 p,float time,float seabed){return (${expression})*clamp((-seabed+${gl(shore.offset)})/${gl(shore.depth)},${gl(shore.min)},${gl(shore.max)});}`;
  return Object.freeze({components,shore,amplitude,height,glsl,maxDisplacement:components.reduce((sum,w)=>sum+w.amplitude,0)});
})();

;
// END src/waves.js
// BEGIN src/coast-foam.js
// Escuma de litoral adaptativa, només per a la qualitat Alt.
// Les franges ressegueixen les corbes hAt(x,z)=0 amb mostres fines:
// les ones mantenen exactament la funció que també usa la física.
window.HUNTER_COAST_FOAM=Object.freeze({
 create(T,{scene,model,heightAt,time,foamColor}){
   const mat=new T.ShaderMaterial({
     uniforms:{time,foamColor:{value:new T.Vector3(...foamColor)}},
     transparent:true,depthWrite:false,depthTest:true,side:T.DoubleSide,
     stencilWrite:true,stencilRef:0,stencilFunc:T.EqualStencilFunc,
     stencilFail:T.KeepStencilOp,stencilZFail:T.KeepStencilOp,
     stencilZPass:T.KeepStencilOp,
     vertexShader:[
       'uniform float time;',
       'attribute float seabed,shoreSide;',
       'varying float vSide;varying vec3 worldP;',
       model.glsl,
       'void main(){',
       '  vec3 p=position;',
       '  vSide=shoreSide;',
       '  p.y=hunterWaveHeight(p.xz,time,seabed)+.09;',
       '  worldP=p;',
       '  gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(p,1.);',
       '}'
     ].join('\n'),
     fragmentShader:[
       'uniform float time;',
       'uniform vec3 foamColor;',
       'varying float vSide;varying vec3 worldP;',
       'void main(){',
       '  float edge=1.-smoothstep(.12,1.,abs(vSide));',
       '  float swell=pow(.5+.5*sin(time*2.3-worldP.x*.21+worldP.z*.14),2.);',
       '  float lace=.5+.5*sin(worldP.x*.73+worldP.z*.59+time*1.45);',
       '  float breakup=.5+.5*sin(worldP.x*.47-worldP.z*.64-time*1.8);',
       '  float alpha=edge*(.19+.52*swell)*(.55+.27*lace+.18*breakup);',
       '  float distanceToCamera=distance(cameraPosition,worldP);',
       '  alpha*=1.-smoothstep(980.,1670.,distanceToCamera);',
       '  if(alpha<.012)discard;',
       '  gl_FragColor=vec4(foamColor,clamp(alpha,0.,.72));',
       '#include <tonemapping_fragment>',
       '#include <colorspace_fragment>',
       '}'
     ].join('\n')
   });
   let geo=new T.BufferGeometry();
   const mesh=new T.Mesh(geo,mat);
   mesh.name='hunter-shore-breakers';mesh.renderOrder=3;
   mesh.frustumCulled=true;mesh.visible=false;scene.add(mesh);
   const stats={segments:0,vertices:0,triangles:0,coastCells:0,sampledPoints:0};
   function regenerate(ocean,segments){const steps=regenerateSteps(ocean,segments);while(!steps.next().done){}}
   function* regenerateSteps(ocean,segments){
     const p=ocean.attributes.position,b=ocean.attributes.seabed,
       row=segments+1,pos=[],beds=[],sides=[],indices=[],
       subdivision=3,halfWidth=5.4,maxSegments=26000;
     let coastCells=0,samples=0,limit=false;
     const H=(x,z)=>{samples++;return heightAt(x,z)};
     function segment(a,c){
       if(pos.length/18>=maxSegments){limit=true;return}
       const dx=c.x-a.x,dz=c.z-a.z,l=Math.hypot(dx,dz);
       if(l<.04)return;
       const nx=-dz/l,nz=dx/l,start=pos.length/3;
       for(const endpoint of[a,c])for(const side of[-1,0,1]){
         const x=endpoint.x+nx*halfWidth*side,
           z=endpoint.z+nz*halfWidth*side;
         pos.push(x,0,z);beds.push(H(x,z));sides.push(side);
       }
       for(let t=0;t<2;t++){
         const a=start+t,b=a+3,c=a+1,d=a+4;
         indices.push(a,b,c,c,b,d);
       }
     }
     function contour(points,heights){
       const edges=[[0,1],[1,2],[2,3],[3,0]],hits=[];
       for(const [a,b] of edges){
         const h0=heights[a],h1=heights[b];
         if((h0>0)===(h1>0))continue;
         const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,h0/(h0-h1)));
         hits.push({
           x:points[a].x+(points[b].x-points[a].x)*t,
           z:points[a].z+(points[b].z-points[a].z)*t
         });
       }
       if(hits.length===2)segment(hits[0],hits[1]);
       else if(hits.length===4){segment(hits[0],hits[1]);segment(hits[2],hits[3]);}
     }
     for(let iz=0;iz<segments&&!limit;iz++)for(let ix=0;ix<segments&&!limit;ix++){
       if((iz*segments+ix)%64===0)yield {stage:'Escuma de costa',completed:iz*segments+ix,total:segments*segments,unit:'cel·les'};
       const k=iz*row+ix,
         h0=b.getX(k),h1=b.getX(k+1),
         h2=b.getX(k+row+1),h3=b.getX(k+row),
         min=Math.min(h0,h1,h2,h3),max=Math.max(h0,h1,h2,h3);
       if(min>3||max< -3)continue;
       coastCells++;
       const x0=p.getX(k),x1=p.getX(k+1),
         z0=p.getZ(k),z1=p.getZ(k+row),local=[];
       for(let iy=0;iy<=subdivision;iy++){
         const line=[];
         for(let ix=0;ix<=subdivision;ix++){
           const x=x0+(x1-x0)*ix/subdivision,
             z=z0+(z1-z0)*iy/subdivision;
           line.push({x,z,h:H(x,z)});
         }
         local.push(line);
       }
       for(let iy=0;iy<subdivision&&!limit;iy++)
         for(let ix=0;ix<subdivision&&!limit;ix++){
           const a=local[iy][ix],c=local[iy][ix+1],
             d=local[iy+1][ix+1],e=local[iy+1][ix];
           contour([a,c,d,e],[a.h,c.h,d.h,e.h]);
         }
     }
     const next=new T.BufferGeometry();
     next.setAttribute('position',new T.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
     next.setAttribute('seabed',new T.Float32BufferAttribute(beds,1));
     next.setAttribute('shoreSide',new T.Float32BufferAttribute(sides,1));
     next.setIndex(indices);
     if(pos.length){
       next.computeBoundingBox();
       next.boundingBox.min.y=-model.maxDisplacement-.1;
       next.boundingBox.max.y=model.maxDisplacement+.1;
       next.computeBoundingSphere();
       next.boundingSphere.radius+=model.maxDisplacement+.1;
     }
     geo.dispose();geo=next;mesh.geometry=geo;
     stats.segments=pos.length/18;
     stats.vertices=pos.length/3;
     stats.triangles=indices.length/3;
     stats.coastCells=coastCells;stats.sampledPoints=samples;
     mesh.visible=stats.segments>0;
   }
   function dispose(){scene.remove(mesh);geo.dispose();mat.dispose()}
   return {mesh,stats,regenerate,regenerateSteps,dispose};
 }
});

;
// END src/coast-foam.js
// BEGIN src/water.js
// Sistema visual de l'aigua, desacoblat de la simulació del joc.
window.HUNTER_WATER_SYSTEM=Object.freeze({
  create(THREE,{scene,sunDir,size,segments,heightAt,config,reflections=true,coastDetail=false,fogColor=0xc99f91,initialSegments=segments}){
    const model=window.HUNTER_WAVES;
    const uniforms={
      time:{value:0},light:{value:sunDir},
      shallow:{value:new THREE.Vector3(...config.shallow)},
      deep:{value:new THREE.Vector3(...config.deep)},
      horizon:{value:new THREE.Vector3(...config.horizon)},
      sunGlint:{value:new THREE.Vector3(...config.sunGlint)},
      foamColor:{value:new THREE.Vector3(...config.foam)},
      fresnelStrength:{value:config.fresnelStrength},
      absorptionDepth:{value:config.absorptionDepth},
      waterFog:{value:config.fogDensity},
      fogHorizon:{value:new THREE.Color(fogColor)}
    };
    const material=new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms,
      // Només el mar consulta la màscara; la resta del món conserva el depth test habitual.
      stencilWrite:true,stencilRef:0,stencilFunc:THREE.EqualStencilFunc,
      stencilFail:THREE.KeepStencilOp,stencilZFail:THREE.KeepStencilOp,stencilZPass:THREE.KeepStencilOp,
      vertexShader:`uniform float time;attribute float seabed;varying vec3 worldP;varying float bed;
${model.glsl}
void main(){vec3 p=position;bed=seabed;p.y=hunterWaveHeight(p.xz,time,seabed);worldP=p;gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(p,1.);}`,
      fragmentShader:reflections?`uniform vec3 light,shallow,deep,horizon,sunGlint,foamColor;uniform float time,fresnelStrength,absorptionDepth,waterFog;varying vec3 worldP;varying float bed;void main(){if(bed>worldP.y+.12)discard;vec3 n=normalize(cross(dFdx(worldP),dFdy(worldP)));if(n.y<0.)n=-n;vec3 v=normalize(cameraPosition-worldP);float nv=max(dot(n,v),0.);float nd=max(dot(n,light),0.);float fres=pow(1.-nv,3.)*fresnelStrength;float spec=pow(max(dot(reflect(-light,n),v),0.),88.);float depth=max(0.,worldP.y-bed);float absorb=1.-exp(-depth/max(absorptionDepth,.01));vec3 c=mix(shallow,deep,clamp(absorb,0.,1.));c*=.78+nd*.48;c=mix(c,horizon,fres);c+=sunGlint*spec*(.65+fres);float zone=(1.-smoothstep(1.8,4.6,depth))*smoothstep(-.1,.22,depth);float crest=pow(clamp(1.-n.y,0.,1.),1.6);float breaker=pow(.5+.5*sin(depth*5.-time*3.8+sin(worldP.x*.16+worldP.z*.12)*.6),7.);float foam=zone*breaker*.82+crest*zone*.55+(1.-smoothstep(.05,.35,depth))*.36;c=mix(c,foamColor,clamp(foam,0.,.92));float dist=distance(cameraPosition,worldP);float fog=1.-exp(-dist*waterFog);c=mix(c,horizon,fog*.72);gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);
#include <tonemapping_fragment>
#include <colorspace_fragment>
}`: `uniform vec3 shallow,deep,foamColor,fogHorizon;
uniform float absorptionDepth;
varying vec3 worldP;
varying float bed;
void main(){
  if(bed>worldP.y+.12)discard;
  // Perfil mínim: l'aigua té color i escuma lleugera, però no calcula
  // reflexos especulars, Fresnel ni normals derivades per fragment.
  float depth=max(0.,worldP.y-bed);
  float waterDepth=depth/(depth+max(8.,absorptionDepth*.8));
  vec3 c=mix(shallow,deep,waterDepth);
  float shoreline=(1.-smoothstep(0.1,1.8,depth))*.22;
  c=mix(c,foamColor,shoreline);
  float distanceToCamera=distance(cameraPosition,worldP);
  c=mix(c,fogHorizon,smoothstep(720.,1400.,distanceToCamera));
  gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);
#include <tonemapping_fragment>
#include <colorspace_fragment>
}`
    });
    // Un mar inicial més lleuger fa possible el primer fotograma ràpid.
    // La malla completa es prepara per franges, sense substituir la malla
    // visible fins que les dades de batimetria estan acabades.
    let worldSize=size,span=size+2200,
        resolution=Math.min(segments,Math.max(16,Math.floor(initialSegments)));
    const makeGeometry=(n=resolution)=>{
      const g=new THREE.PlaneGeometry(span,span,n,n).rotateX(-Math.PI/2);
      g.setAttribute('seabed',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(g.attributes.position.count),1));
      g.computeBoundingBox();g.boundingBox.min.y=-model.maxDisplacement;g.boundingBox.max.y=model.maxDisplacement;
      g.boundingSphere=new THREE.Sphere(new THREE.Vector3(),Math.hypot(span/Math.sqrt(2),model.maxDisplacement));
      return g;
    };
    let geometry=makeGeometry(),refinement=null;
    const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,material);mesh.name='hunter-water';mesh.renderOrder=2;scene.add(mesh);
    const deep=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30000,30000).rotateX(-Math.PI/2),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x062679}));
    deep.position.y=-90;scene.add(deep);
    const shore=coastDetail?window.HUNTER_COAST_FOAM.create(THREE,{
      scene,model,heightAt,time:uniforms.time,foamColor:config.foam
    }):null;
    const seabedStats={lastSamples:0,totalVertices:0};
    // Exactament el mateix càlcul que el mostreig síncron anterior, però
    // dividit en files per poder-lo repartir entre fotogrames.
    const sampler=(g,nseg)=>{
      const p=g.attributes.position,b=g.attributes.seabed,
            width=nseg+1,stride=nseg>=300?3:2,stops=[];
      for(let i=0;i<nseg;i+=stride)stops.push(i);
      stops.push(nseg);
      const n=stops.length,coarse=new Float32Array(n*n),arr=b.array;
      let coarseRow=0,fillRow=0,samples=0,done=false;
      const step=(units=4)=>{
        for(let unit=0;unit<units&&!done;unit++){
          if(coarseRow<n){
            for(let rx=0;rx<n;rx++){
              const id=stops[coarseRow]*width+stops[rx];
              coarse[coarseRow*n+rx]=heightAt(p.getX(id),p.getZ(id));samples++;
            }
            coarseRow++;continue;
          }
          if(fillRow<n-1){
            const rz=fillRow++;
            for(let rx=0;rx<n-1;rx++){
              const za=stops[rz],zb=stops[rz+1],xa=stops[rx],xb=stops[rx+1],
                    a=coarse[rz*n+rx],bb=coarse[rz*n+rx+1],
                    c=coarse[(rz+1)*n+rx],d=coarse[(rz+1)*n+rx+1],
                    exactCoast=Math.min(a,bb,c,d)<14&&Math.max(a,bb,c,d)>-14;
              for(let iz=za;iz<(rz===n-2?zb+1:zb);iz++){
                const tz=(iz-za)/(zb-za),row=iz*width;
                for(let ix=xa;ix<(rx===n-2?xb+1:xb);ix++){
                  const tx=(ix-xa)/(xb-xa),
                        h=(a*(1-tx)+bb*tx)*(1-tz)+(c*(1-tx)+d*tx)*tz,
                        index=row+ix;
                  if(exactCoast||(h>-14&&h<14)){
                    arr[index]=heightAt(p.getX(index),p.getZ(index));samples++;
                  }else arr[index]=h;
                }
              }
            }
            continue;
          }
          b.needsUpdate=true;done=true;
        }
        return done;
      };
      return {step,get samples(){return samples},vertices:p.count};
    };
    function* updateSeabedSteps(){
      const job=sampler(geometry,resolution);let rows=0;
      while(!job.step(1))yield {stage:'Fons marí',completed:++rows,total:null,unit:'files'};
      seabedStats.lastSamples=job.samples;seabedStats.totalVertices=job.vertices;
      if(shore)yield* shore.regenerateSteps(geometry,resolution);
    }
    const updateSeabed=()=>{const steps=updateSeabedSteps();while(!steps.next().done){}};
    const queueResolutionUpgrade=()=>{
      if(resolution>=segments||refinement)return false;
      const nextGeometry=makeGeometry(segments);
      refinement={geometry:nextGeometry,task:sampler(nextGeometry,segments)};
      return true;
    };
    const stepResolutionUpgrade=(budget=3)=>{
      if(!refinement)return resolution>=segments;
      if(!refinement.task.step(Math.max(1,Math.floor(budget))))return false;
      const old=geometry;
      geometry=refinement.geometry;resolution=segments;mesh.geometry=geometry;
      seabedStats.lastSamples=refinement.task.samples;
      seabedStats.totalVertices=refinement.task.vertices;
      refinement=null;old.dispose();
      if(shore)shore.regenerate(geometry,resolution);
      return true;
    };
    const cancelRefinement=()=>{
      if(refinement){refinement.geometry.dispose();refinement=null}
    };
    function* setWorldSizeSteps(value){
      cancelRefinement();
      if(value!==worldSize){
        worldSize=value;span=value+2200;
        const old=geometry;geometry=makeGeometry();mesh.geometry=geometry;old.dispose();
      }
      yield* updateSeabedSteps();
    }
    const setWorldSize=value=>{const steps=setWorldSizeSteps(value);while(!steps.next().done){}};
    // Barycentric interpolation of the SAME vertices/triangles displaced by the shader.
    // This avoids floating above/below the rendered surface on coarse mobile meshes.
    const surfaceHeight=(x,z,time)=>{
      if(Math.abs(x)>span/2||Math.abs(z)>span/2)return model.height(x,z,time,heightAt(x,z));
      const p=geometry.attributes.position,b=geometry.attributes.seabed,stride=resolution+1;
      const ix=Math.min(resolution-1,Math.max(0,Math.floor((x/span+.5)*resolution)));
      const iz=Math.min(resolution-1,Math.max(0,Math.floor((z/span+.5)*resolution)));
      const a=iz*stride+ix,c=a+stride+1,d=a+1,bb=a+stride;
      const fx=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(x-p.getX(a))/(p.getX(d)-p.getX(a))));
      const fz=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(z-p.getZ(a))/(p.getZ(bb)-p.getZ(a))));
      const h=i=>model.height(p.getX(i),p.getZ(i),time,b.getX(i));
      return fx+fz<=1?h(a)*(1-fx-fz)+h(d)*fx+h(bb)*fz:h(c)*(fx+fz-1)+h(bb)*(1-fx)+h(d)*(1-fz);
    };
    const update=t=>{uniforms.time.value=t};
    const dispose=()=>{cancelRefinement();if(shore)shore.dispose();scene.remove(mesh,deep);geometry.dispose();material.dispose();deep.geometry.dispose();deep.material.dispose()};
    return {mesh,deep,shore:shore?.mesh||null,shoreStats:shore?.stats||{segments:0},
      material,get geometry(){return geometry},get resolution(){return resolution},uniforms,updateSeabed,updateSeabedSteps,setWorldSize,setWorldSizeSteps,queueResolutionUpgrade,stepResolutionUpgrade,surfaceHeight,update,dispose,seabedStats};
  }
});


;
// END src/water.js
// BEGIN src/terrain.js
// Terreny visible per sectors: mateixa funció d'altura que la simulació,
// però malles amb LOD i construcció repartida entre fotogrames.
const HUNTER_TERRAIN_PALETTE=Object.freeze([
  [-75,0x04143c],[-18,0x075d8a],[-6,0x0d91b0],[-1.5,0xeac45e],
  [.5,0xffd975],[3.5,0xe9b54a],[5,0x66ef1f],[14,0x34c83b],
  [22,0x149f34],[30,0x138d31],[40,0x0f7b2b]
]);
function hunterTerrainBandAt(h){
  const p=HUNTER_TERRAIN_PALETTE;
  let i=0;
  while(i<p.length-2&&h>p[i+1][0])i++;
  return i;
}
window.HUNTER_TERRAIN=Object.freeze({
  palette:HUNTER_TERRAIN_PALETTE,
  colorAt(THREE,h){
    // Aquesta funció també es passa deslligada al minimapa.
    // No ha de dependre del valor de "this".
    const p=HUNTER_TERRAIN_PALETTE,i=hunterTerrainBandAt(h);
    if(i>=p.length-1)return new THREE.Color(p[p.length-1][1]);
    const a=p[i],b=p[i+1],t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(h-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0])));
    return new THREE.Color(a[1]).lerp(new THREE.Color(b[1]),t);
  },
  bandAt(h){return hunterTerrainBandAt(h)},
  create(THREE,options){
    const steps=this.createSteps(THREE,options);let next;
    while(!(next=steps.next()).done){}return next.value;
  },
  *createSteps(THREE,{size,segments,heightAt,material,startX=0,startZ=0,lowQuality=false,quality=null,shadows=false,cutouts=[],parent=null}){
    const root=new THREE.Group();
    root.name='hunter-terrain-stream';
    if(parent)parent.add(root);
    // Un forat precís al terreny deixa el soterrani sota el búnquer buit:
    // no modificam hAt (ni l'orografia ni les rutes), i funciona amb tots
    // els nivells LOD sense vores esglaonades ni regenerar sectors.
    // El material de retallada s'utilitza només als sectors que travessen
    // el búnquer. La resta conserva el shader ordinari, sense discard.
    const cutoutMaterial=cutouts.length?material.clone():null;
    const cutoutBounds=cutouts.length?cutouts.map(cut=>{
      const c=Math.cos(cut.angle),s=Math.sin(cut.angle);
      return {x:cut.x,z:cut.z,
        hx:Math.abs(c)*cut.halfWidth+Math.abs(s)*cut.halfDepth,
        hz:Math.abs(s)*cut.halfWidth+Math.abs(c)*cut.halfDepth};
    }):[];
    if(cutoutMaterial){
      const cut=cutouts[0],c=Math.cos(cut.angle),s=Math.sin(cut.angle);
      // La textura HD s'actualitza després de generar el món; el material
      // especial ha de rebre el mateix mapa sense tornar-lo a crear.
      material.userData.hunterCutoutMaterial=cutoutMaterial;
      cutoutMaterial.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
        shader.uniforms.hunterCutout={value:new THREE.Vector4(cut.x,cut.z,c,s)};
        shader.uniforms.hunterCutoutSize={value:new THREE.Vector2(cut.halfWidth,cut.halfDepth)};
        shader.vertexShader='varying vec2 hunterTerrainXZ;\n'+shader.vertexShader.replace(
          '#include <begin_vertex>',
          '#include <begin_vertex>\n hunterTerrainXZ=(modelMatrix*vec4(position,1.0)).xz;');
        shader.fragmentShader='varying vec2 hunterTerrainXZ;\nuniform vec4 hunterCutout;\nuniform vec2 hunterCutoutSize;\n'+
          shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <clipping_planes_fragment>',
            '#include <clipping_planes_fragment>\n vec2 hunterD=hunterTerrainXZ-hunterCutout.xy;\n vec2 hunterL=vec2(dot(hunterD,hunterCutout.zw),dot(hunterD,vec2(-hunterCutout.w,hunterCutout.z)));\n if(all(lessThan(abs(hunterL),hunterCutoutSize)))discard;');
      };
      cutoutMaterial.customProgramCacheKey=()=>`hunter-bunker-cutout-v2`;
    }
    const tileSize=800,side=Math.ceil(size/tileSize),cellSize=size/side,half=size/2;
    // Conservam la resolució propera per mantenir el contacte amb peus i
    // rodes, però simplificam molt abans els sectors intermedis i llunyans.
    const profile=quality||(lowQuality?'mobile':'desktop');
    const configs={
      desktop:{levels:[5,10,20,64],ranges:[410,1120,2060]},
      mobile:{levels:[3,6,12,40],ranges:[290,700,1350]},
      ultra:{levels:[2,4,8,24],ranges:[165,440,900]}
    };
    const profileConfig=configs[profile]||configs.desktop,
          levels=profileConfig.levels,ranges=profileConfig.ranges,margin=50;
    const palette=HUNTER_TERRAIN_PALETTE.map(([h,c])=>{
      const rgb=new THREE.Color(c);return {h,r:rgb.r,g:rgb.g,b:rgb.b};
    });
    const tileUsesCutout=tile=>cutoutBounds.some(cut=>
      Math.abs(tile.cx-cut.x)<=cellSize/2+cut.hx&&
      Math.abs(tile.cz-cut.z)<=cellSize/2+cut.hz);
    const tiles=[];
    let disposed=false,job=null,lastPlayerX=startX,lastPlayerZ=startZ,
        settled=false,lastSettledX=Infinity,lastSettledZ=Infinity,lastFocusKey='';
    const stats={profile,initialTiles:0,visibleTiles:0,generatedTiles:0,upgradedTiles:0,processedVertices:0,totalTiles:side*side,
      lodLevels:[...levels],lodRanges:[...ranges],lodTiles:[0,0,0,0],terrainTriangles:0,terrainShadowTiles:0,
      farTiles:0,viewPriority:false,settledSkips:0,scans:0};
    // The material is shared by all tiles. A single shader compilation is needed.
    function colorAtHeight(h,out,k){
      let i=0;
      while(i<palette.length-2&&h>palette[i+1].h)i++;
      const a=palette[i],b=palette[i+1],
            t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(h-a.h)/(b.h-a.h)));
      // Banda de sorra humida en el perfil Alt: fa més natural la
      // transició de l'escuma amb la costa, sense tocar la simulació.
      const wet=profile==='desktop'&&h>-.6&&h<3
        ?Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(h-.65)/2.35)*.12:0;
      out[k]=(a.r+(b.r-a.r)*t)*(1-wet);
      out[k+1]=(a.g+(b.g-a.g)*t)*(1-wet);
      out[k+2]=(a.b+(b.b-a.b)*t)*(1-wet);
    }
    for(let z=0;z<side;z++)for(let x=0;x<side;x++){
      const cx=-half+(x+.5)*cellSize,cz=-half+(z+.5)*cellSize;
      tiles.push({x,z,cx,cz,geometry:null,mesh:null,level:-1});
    }
    function distance2(tile,x,z){
      const dx=Math.max(0,Math.abs(tile.cx-x)-cellSize/2),
            dz=Math.max(0,Math.abs(tile.cz-z)-cellSize/2);
      return dx*dx+dz*dz;
    }
    function targetLevel(tile,x,z,focus=null){
      if(focus?.intersectsXZBox(tile.cx,tile.cz,cellSize/2))return 3;
      const distance=Math.sqrt(distance2(tile,x,z));
      let level=tile.level<0?
        (distance<ranges[0]?3:distance<ranges[1]?2:distance<ranges[2]?1:0):
        tile.level;
      // Histeresi de 50 m: una petita oscil·lació de posició no força
      // a recrear les malles i tornar-les a pujar a la GPU.
      if(tile.level>=0){
        while(level<3&&distance<ranges[2-level]-margin)level++;
        while(level>0&&distance>ranges[3-level]+margin)level--;
      }
      return level;
    }
    function appendSkirts(geometry,n){
      // Faldons al límit entre sectors de diferent LOD: amaguen petites
      // escletxes sense canviar les altures emprades per les col·lisions.
      const original=geometry.attributes.position,
            colors=geometry.attributes.color,
            sourceUV=geometry.attributes.uv,
            base=original.count,edges=[],row=n+1;
      for(let i=0;i<=n;i++)edges.push(i);
      for(let i=0;i<=n;i++)edges.push(i*row+n);
      for(let i=n;i>=0;i--)edges.push(n*row+i);
      for(let i=n;i>=0;i--)edges.push(i*row);
      const skirtCount=edges.length*2,
            pos=new Float32Array((base+skirtCount)*3),
            col=new Float32Array((base+skirtCount)*3),
            uv=(material.map||material.userData?.requiresDetailUV)&&sourceUV?new Float32Array((base+skirtCount)*2):null,
            oldIx=geometry.index.array,
            indices=new Uint16Array(oldIx.length+edges.length*6);
      pos.set(original.array);col.set(colors.array);indices.set(oldIx);
      if(uv)uv.set(sourceUV.array);
      let at=oldIx.length;
      for(let i=0;i<edges.length;i++){
        const src=edges[i],a=base+2*i,b=a+1,k=src*3;
        pos.set([pos[k],pos[k+1],pos[k+2]],a*3);
        pos.set([pos[k],pos[k+1]-18,pos[k+2]],b*3);
        col.set([col[k],col[k+1],col[k+2]],a*3);
        col.set([col[k],col[k+1],col[k+2]],b*3);
        if(uv){
          const j=src*2;
          uv.set([uv[j],uv[j+1]],a*2);
          uv.set([uv[j],uv[j+1]],b*2);
        }
        if(i%row===row-1)continue;
        const c=a+2,d=b+2;
        indices[at++]=a;indices[at++]=b;indices[at++]=c;
        indices[at++]=c;indices[at++]=b;indices[at++]=d;
      }
      geometry.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos,3));
      geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(col,3));
      if(uv)geometry.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.BufferAttribute(uv,2));
      geometry.setIndex(new THREE.BufferAttribute(indices.slice(0,at),1));
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();
    }
    function begin(tile,level){
      const n=levels[level],geometry=new THREE.PlaneGeometry(cellSize,cellSize,n,n);
      geometry.rotateX(-Math.PI/2);
      const p=geometry.attributes.position,colors=new Float32Array(p.count*3);
      return {tile,level,geometry,p,colors,next:0};
    }
    function process(task,limit){
      const {p,colors,tile}=task;
      const end=Math.min(p.count,task.next+limit);
      for(let i=task.next;i<end;i++){
        const h=heightAt(tile.cx+p.getX(i),tile.cz+p.getZ(i));
        p.setY(i,h);colorAtHeight(h,colors,i*3);
      }
      stats.processedVertices+=end-task.next;task.next=end;
      return end===p.count;
    }
    function finish(task){
      const {tile,geometry,colors,level}=task;
      geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors,3));
      appendSkirts(geometry,levels[level]);
      const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,
        cutoutMaterial&&tileUsesCutout(tile)?cutoutMaterial:material);
      mesh.name='hunter-terrain-tile';
      mesh.position.set(tile.cx,0,tile.cz);
      mesh.userData.terrainTile=true;
      // Sols les malles immediates reben ombres: estalvi de GPU als
      // vessants llunyans, especialment mirant terra endins.
      mesh.userData.terrainNearShadow=shadows&&level===3;
      mesh.receiveShadow=mesh.userData.terrainNearShadow;mesh.castShadow=false;
      mesh.frustumCulled=true;
      if(tile.mesh){
        root.remove(tile.mesh);
        tile.geometry.dispose();
        stats.upgradedTiles++;
      }else{
        stats.generatedTiles++;
        stats.visibleTiles++;
      }
      if(tile.level===0)stats.farTiles--;
      tile.mesh=mesh;tile.geometry=geometry;tile.level=level;
      if(level===0)stats.farTiles++;
      root.add(mesh);
      stats.lodTiles=[0,0,0,0];
      stats.terrainTriangles=0;stats.terrainShadowTiles=0;
      for(const current of tiles)if(current.mesh){
        stats.lodTiles[current.level]++;
        stats.terrainTriangles+=current.geometry.index.count/3;
        if(current.mesh.receiveShadow)stats.terrainShadowTiles++;
      }
    }
    function generateNow(tile,level){
      const task=begin(tile,level);
      while(!process(task,512)){}
      finish(task);
    }
    let initialComplete=false;
    try{
    // A l'arrencada només es prepara el sector inicial i les seves
    // vuit caselles veïnes. Això evita malles buides sota el jugador.
    for(const tile of tiles){
      if(Math.abs(tile.cx-startX)<cellSize*1.5&&Math.abs(tile.cz-startZ)<cellSize*1.5){
        const level=distance2(tile,startX,startZ)<1?3:targetLevel(tile,startX,startZ);
        const task=begin(tile,level);let committed=false;
        try{
          while(!process(task,256))yield {stage:'Terreny inicial',completed:task.next,total:task.p.count,unit:'vèrtexs'};
          finish(task);committed=true;stats.initialTiles++;
        }finally{if(!committed)task.geometry.dispose()}
        yield {stage:'Terreny inicial',completed:stats.initialTiles,total:null,unit:'sectors'};
      }
    }
    function pick(x,z,focus=null){
      let chosen=null,best=-Infinity,desired=0;
      stats.scans++;
      for(const tile of tiles){
        const wanted=targetLevel(tile,x,z,focus);
        if(tile.level===wanted)continue;
        const d=distance2(tile,x,z);
        // Prioritat geogràfica estable, independent dels canvis de càmera.
        // Evitem comprovar la intersecció de tots els sectors a cada fotograma.
        const priority=(focus?.intersectsXZBox(tile.cx,tile.cz,cellSize/2)?22000000:0)+
          (tile.level<0?11000000:0)+
          (wanted===3?8000000:wanted===2?4000000:wanted===1?2000000:0)-
          d+(tile.level>wanted?-2500000:0);
        if(priority>best){chosen=tile;best=priority;desired=wanted}
      }
      return chosen?begin(chosen,desired):null;
    }
    function update(x,z,budgetMs=2,camera=null,focus=null){
      if(disposed)return;
      lastPlayerX=x;lastPlayerZ=z;
      const focusKey=focus?.key||'';
      if(focusKey!==lastFocusKey){
        lastFocusKey=focusKey;settled=false;
        if(job){job.geometry.dispose();job=null}
      }
      // Quan tot el terreny està actualitzat no tornem a escanejar-lo cada
      // fotograma; reavaluem en desplaçar-nos 90 m o si hi ha un treball obert.
      if(!job&&settled&&Math.abs(x-lastSettledX)<90&&Math.abs(z-lastSettledZ)<90){
        stats.settledSkips++;return;
      }
      if(settled){settled=false;}
      const start=performance.now(),budget=Math.max(.5,Math.min(4,budgetMs));
      let loops=0;
      while(performance.now()-start<budget&&loops++<60){
        if(!job)job=pick(lastPlayerX,lastPlayerZ,focus);
        if(!job){settled=true;lastSettledX=x;lastSettledZ=z;break;}
        if(process(job,160)){
          finish(job);job=null;
          // Només pugem una malla nova a GPU per fotograma.
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    // Road decals only refit when their own terrain tile changes LOD.
    function surfaceVersionAt(x,z){
      const ix=Math.max(0,Math.min(side-1,Math.floor((x+half)/cellSize))),iz=Math.max(0,Math.min(side-1,Math.floor((z+half)/cellSize)));
      return tiles[iz*side+ix]?.geometry?.id??0;
    }
    // Alçada real dels triangles visibles (no la funció contínua de física).
    // Una malla LOD interpola els seus vèrtexs: pot quedar per sobre de heightAt.
    function visibleHeightAt(x,z){
      if(disposed||x<-half||x>half||z<-half||z>half)return null;
      // Només examinem les caselles que poden contenir el punt.
      // A les costures el sector de l'altre costat també pot ser visible.
      const tx=Math.floor((x+half)/cellSize),tz=Math.floor((z+half)/cellSize);
      let best=null;
      for(let iz=Math.max(0,tz-1);iz<=Math.min(side-1,tz+1);iz++){
        for(let ix=Math.max(0,tx-1);ix<=Math.min(side-1,tx+1);ix++){
          const tile=tiles[iz*side+ix];
          if(!tile?.geometry||tile.level<0)continue;
          const left=tile.cx-cellSize/2,front=tile.cz-cellSize/2;
          // PlaneGeometry.rotateX(-PI/2): row 0 ends at MINIMUM world Z.
          // Previously Z was reversed, sampling the opposite hillside.
          const uWorld=x-left,vWorld=z-front;
          // Una tolerància petita inclou les dues vores, sense projectar
          // l'altura de sectors distants sobre el jugador.
          if(uWorld<-.0001||uWorld>cellSize+.0001||
             vWorld<-.0001||vWorld>cellSize+.0001)continue;
          const n=levels[tile.level],step=cellSize/n,row=n+1;
          const u=Math.max(0,Math.min(n-1e-8,uWorld/step));
          const v=Math.max(0,Math.min(n-1e-8,vWorld/step));
          const i=Math.floor(u),j=Math.floor(v),fu=u-i,fv=v-j;
          const p=tile.geometry.attributes.position;
          const a=j*row+i,b=(j+1)*row+i,c=b+1,d=a+1;
          // Mateixa diagonal que els índexs de THREE.PlaneGeometry.
          const h=fu+fv<=1
            ?p.getY(a)+(p.getY(d)-p.getY(a))*fu+(p.getY(b)-p.getY(a))*fv
            :p.getY(c)+(p.getY(b)-p.getY(c))*(1-fu)+(p.getY(d)-p.getY(c))*(1-fv);
          if(best===null||h>best)best=h;
        }
      }
      return best;
    }
    function dispose(){
      disposed=true;
      if(job){job.geometry.dispose();job=null}
      for(const tile of tiles)if(tile.geometry){tile.geometry.dispose();tile.geometry=null}
      root.clear();cutoutMaterial?.dispose();material.dispose();
    }
    initialComplete=true;
    return {mesh:root,update,dispose,visibleHeightAt,surfaceVersionAt,stats,tileSize:cellSize,get pending(){return !!job}};
    }finally{
      if(!initialComplete){
        for(const tile of tiles)if(tile.geometry)tile.geometry.dispose();
        root.parent?.remove(root);root.clear();cutoutMaterial?.dispose();material.dispose();
      }
    }
  },
  createBorder(THREE,{size,halfSize}){
    const group=new THREE.Group();
    const solid=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xffffff,fog:false});
    const wall=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color:0xcbe7ff,transparent:true,opacity:.16,
      side:THREE.DoubleSide,fog:false,depthWrite:false
    });
    [[0,-halfSize,0],[0,halfSize,0],[-halfSize,0,1],[halfSize,0,1]].forEach(([x,z,r])=>{
      const bar=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(size,1.2,2.5),solid);
      const plane=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(size,72),wall);
      bar.position.set(x,1.5,z);plane.position.set(x,36,z);
      if(r)bar.rotation.y=plane.rotation.y=Math.PI/2;
      group.add(bar,plane);
    });
    return group;
  }
});

;
// END src/terrain.js
// BEGIN src/sniper-focus.js
// Òptica x8: només el corredor de la mira exigeix LOD complet.
// L'altura real de les illes i el resultat de la llavor no es modifiquen.
window.HUNTER_SCOPE_FOCUS=Object.freeze({
  create(x,y,z,yaw,pitch){
    const cp=Math.cos(pitch),dx=-Math.sin(yaw)*cp,
          dy=Math.sin(pitch),dz=-Math.cos(yaw)*cp,
          maxDistance=2200,halfAngle=.105;
    const key=Math.round(yaw/.035)+':'+Math.round(pitch/.035)+':'+
      Math.round(x/35)+':'+Math.round(z/35);
    const contains=(px,py,pz,radius=0)=>{
      const ax=px-x,ay=py-y,az=pz-z,
            along=ax*dx+ay*dy+az*dz;
      if(along<0||along>maxDistance+radius)return false;
      const sideways=Math.max(0,ax*ax+ay*ay+az*az-along*along),
            allowed=halfAngle*along+Math.max(0,radius);
      return sideways<=allowed*allowed;
    };
    // Raig contra els límits XZ del sector. Té en compte els objectes propers
    // a les vores encara que el centre del sector quedi fora de la mira.
    const intersectsXZBox=(cx,cz,halfSize,extra=10)=>{
      let enter=0,leave=maxDistance;
      for(const [origin,direction,lo,hi] of [
        [x,dx,cx-halfSize-extra,cx+halfSize+extra],
        [z,dz,cz-halfSize-extra,cz+halfSize+extra]
      ]){
        if(Math.abs(direction)<1e-8){
          if(origin<lo||origin>hi)return false;
        }else{
          const t1=(lo-origin)/direction,t2=(hi-origin)/direction;
          enter=Math.max(enter,Math.min(t1,t2));
          leave=Math.min(leave,Math.max(t1,t2));
          if(enter>leave)return false;
        }
      }
      return leave>=0;
    };
    return {x,y,z,dx,dy,dz,maxDistance,key,contains,intersectsXZBox};
  }
});

;
// END src/sniper-focus.js
// BEGIN src/civilian-cars.js
// Cotxes civils clàssics: quatre siluetes en Three.js i sis colors.
 // La mateixa fàbrica s'empra al joc i a la pàgina de proves.
window.HUNTER_CIVILIAN_CARS=Object.freeze({
  colors:Object.freeze([
    Object.freeze({name:'Vermell',hex:0xd34e3d}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Blanc',hex:0xe7e8dc}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Blau',hex:0x4b9fd1}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Groc',hex:0xe4b83f}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Verd',hex:0x609969}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Marró',hex:0x896244}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Negre',hex:0x181c1e})
  ]),
  jetskiColors:Object.freeze([
    Object.freeze({name:'Vermell',hex:0xc94e3f}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Verd llima',hex:0xa4ec24}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Groc viu',hex:0xffdf18}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Rosa magenta',hex:0xef35a8}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Blau elèctric',hex:0x228fef}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Taronja',hex:0xff7b19}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Negre',hex:0x181c1e})
  ]),
  variants:Object.freeze([
    Object.freeze({name:'Berlina clàssica',description:'Sedan de tres volums, graella cromada i fars rectangulars, inspirat en la fotografia.',length:5.35,width:2.88,roof:2.67,front:.19,rear:.18,roofRear:.11}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Compacte urbà',description:'Carrosseria més curta, sostre alt, capó breu i finestres quadrades.',length:4.72,width:2.75,roof:2.79,front:.17,rear:.18,roofRear:.12}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Familiar',description:'Cinc portes, sostre llarg, porta posterior gairebé vertical i maleter ampli.',length:5.75,width:2.91,roof:2.75,front:.20,rear:.35,roofRear:.30}),
    Object.freeze({name:'Cupè fastback',description:'Sostre baix, parabrisa inclinat, posterior descendent i frontal allargat.',length:5.30,width:2.86,roof:2.41,front:.21,rear:.25,roofRear:.035})
  ]),
  build(THREE,group,{box,wheel,rod,material,color=0x4b9fd1,variant=0}){
    const v=this.variants[Math.max(0,Math.min(3,variant|0))];
    const l=v.length,w=v.width,mid=w*.42,paint=color;
    const metal=0xbcc3c2,trim=0x273137,glass=0x6b9fb0;
    const B=(width,height,depth,col,x,y,z,profile='paint')=>
      box(group,width,height,depth,col,x,y,z,profile);
    const R=(a,b,r,col,profile='metal')=>rod(group,a,b,r,col,profile);
    // Xarrís, baixos i tres volums; la silueta continua sent visible des de lluny.
    B(w-.10,.34,l-.1,0x333b3b,0,.74,0,'metal');
    B(w,.86,l-.10,paint,0,1.19,0);
    B(w-.12,.17,l-.17,paint,0,1.69,0);
    const frontBase=-l*v.front,rearBase=l*v.rear;
    const frontTop=-l*(v.front-.09),rearTop=l*v.roofRear;
    const topY=v.roof,baseY=1.73;
    // Habitacle trapezoïdal de quatre cares, amb sostre real i vidres laterals.
    const roof=new THREE.Shape();
    roof.moveTo(-rearBase,baseY);
    roof.lineTo(-rearTop,topY);
    roof.lineTo(-frontTop,topY);
    roof.lineTo(-frontBase,baseY);
    roof.closePath();
    const roofGeo=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(roof,{depth:w*.84,bevelEnabled:false,curveSegments:1});
    roofGeo.rotateY(Math.PI/2);
    roofGeo.translate(-w*.42,0,0);
    const roofMesh=new THREE.Mesh(roofGeo,material(paint,'paint'));
    group.add(roofMesh);
    const windows=[[-rearBase,-rearTop,-.05],[-.025,-frontTop,-frontBase]];
    for(const side of [-1,1]){
      // Vidres independents delimitats pel muntant central, sense transparències.
      const glassMat=material(glass,'glass');
      glassMat.side=THREE.DoubleSide;
      for(const [uBack,uUpper,uFront] of windows){
        const shape=new THREE.Shape();
        shape.moveTo(uBack,baseY+.085);
        shape.lineTo(uUpper,topY-.105);
        shape.lineTo(uFront,topY-.105);
        shape.lineTo(uFront+.10,baseY+.085);
        shape.closePath();
        const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ShapeGeometry(shape),glassMat);
        m.rotation.y=Math.PI/2;
        m.position.x=side*(w*.42+.018);
        group.add(m);
      }
      B(.065,topY-baseY+.07,.08,paint,side*(w*.42+.02),(baseY+topY)/2,.02);
      B(.065,.44,.07,trim,side*(w/2+.02),1.42,l*.09,'metal');
      B(.07,.20,.26,metal,side*(w/2+.09),1.86,-l*.14,'metal');
      // Manetes i línies de separació de portes.
      for(const z of [-.60,.91])B(.085,.07,.29,metal,side*(w/2+.025),1.58,z,'metal');
      B(.055,.06,l*.59,trim,side*(w/2+.024),1.07,.08,'metal');
    }
    // Llunes del davant i del darrere, lleument inclinades.
    const windshield=B(w*.72,.70,.08,glass,0,(baseY+topY)/2,-l*(v.front-.045),'glass');
    windshield.rotation.x=-.20;
    const rearWindow=B(w*.71,.58,.07,glass,0,(baseY+topY)/2,l*(v.rear-.045),'glass');
    rearWindow.rotation.x=variant===2?-.06:.18;
    // Capó i maleter amb línies fines visibles.
    B(w-.12,.10,Math.max(.6,l*.5+frontBase),paint,0,1.71,(-l/2+frontBase)/2);
    B(w-.12,.10,Math.max(.45,l/2-rearBase),paint,0,1.71,(l/2+rearBase)/2);
    B(w*.89,.25,.13,0x9aa7a9,0,1.30,-l/2-.06,'metal');
    B(w*.89,.25,.13,0x9aa7a9,0,1.30,l/2+.06,'metal');
    B(w*.57,.42,.09,0x414e54,0,1.48,-l/2-.085,'metal');
    for(const x of [-w*.315,w*.315]){
      const lamp=B(w*.19,.32,.095,0xece9cb,x,1.54,-l/2-.09);
      B(.16,.16,.1,0xf0a43d,x,1.26,-l/2-.09);
      B(w*.18,.21,.09,0xb5362a,x,1.53,l/2+.088);
    }
    for(const x of [-.53,-.28,-.03,.22,.47])B(.045,.29,.10,metal,x,1.48,-l/2-.15,'metal');
    B(.59,.19,.045,0xe2ddc8,0,1.16,l/2+.15);
    // Les quatre rodes passen pels pivots de direcció ja existents.
    for(const z of [-l*.335,l*.335])for(const side of [-1,1]){
      wheel(group,side*(w/2+.035),.69,z,.68,.38,false,z<0);
      B(.14,.15,.57,paint,side*(w/2+.065),1.26,z);
    }
    // Petites particularitats que fan recognoscibles els quatre models.
    if(variant===0){
      for(const x of[-w*.44,w*.44])R([x,1.15,-l*.48],[x,1.15,-l*.52],.068,metal);
    }else if(variant===1){
      B(.72,.08,.45,trim,0,topY+.06,.2,'metal');
    }else if(variant===2){
      for(const x of [-w*.34,w*.34])R([x,topY+.075,-l*.1],[x,topY+.075,l*.27],.045,metal);
      B(w*.72,.19,.14,metal,0,1.35,l/2+.085,'metal');
    }else{
      B(w*.78,.09,.46,paint,0,1.83,l*.37);
      B(w*.62,.10,.11,trim,0,1.63,l/2+.10,'metal');
    }
    group.userData.civilianVariant=variant;
    group.userData.civilianColor=color;
    return group;
  }
});

;
// END src/civilian-cars.js
// BEGIN src/vehicles.js
// Fàbrica visual de vehicles. No conté física, controls ni regles de conducció.
window.HUNTER_VEHICLES=Object.freeze({
  scales:Object.freeze({llanxa:1.95,llanxa_coets:1.95,moto_aquatica:1.08,barca_rems:.98,windsurf:1.05,hover:1.3,ferry:1,cotxe:1.3,cotxe_civil:1.2,moto:1.2,bici:1.2,camio:1.8125,tanqueta:1.8125,tanc:2.25,heli:1.75,heli_combat:1.82}),
  radii:Object.freeze({llanxa:8.25,llanxa_coets:8.6,moto_aquatica:2.1,barca_rems:3.25,windsurf:2.3,hover:4.8,ferry:35,cotxe:3.8,cotxe_civil:3.35,moto:2.2,bici:1.9,camio:4.8,tanqueta:4.5,tanc:5.6,heli:8,heli_combat:8.4}),
  hitboxes:Object.freeze({
    llanxa:[6.6,15.9],llanxa_coets:[6.8,16.1],moto_aquatica:[1.7,3.8],barca_rems:[2.7,6.1],windsurf:[1.9,4.3],hover:[4.2,7.4],ferry:[32,63],
    cotxe:[4.10,6.45],cotxe_civil:[3.2,5.85],moto:[1.35,2.8],bici:[1.15,2.4],camio:[3.6,7.8],tanqueta:[3.15,5.1],tanc:[4.2,7.1],
    heli:[3.4,11.2],heli_combat:[2.8,11.8]
  }),
  decks:Object.freeze({ferry:Object.freeze({halfW:14.3,halfL:25.6,rampHalfW:6.7,ramp:5.8,y:2.2,rampY:.45,
    cabin:Object.freeze({x:11.5,z:1.8,halfW:1.9,halfL:4.05})})}),
  steeringMax:Object.freeze({bici:.60,moto:.52,cotxe:.44,cotxe_civil:.43,camio:.36,tanqueta:.34}),
  // Els pivots giren en Y, per separat de les rodes que roden en X.
  animateSteering(model,type,turn,dt){
    const pivots=model?.userData?.steeringPivots;
    if(!pivots?.length)return;
    const max=this.steeringMax[type]||0,target=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,turn||0))*max,
          a=1-Math.exp(-11*Math.max(0,dt));
    for(const pivot of pivots){
      pivot.rotation.y+=(target-pivot.rotation.y)*a;
      if(Math.abs(pivot.rotation.y)<.0001&&Math.abs(target)<.0001)pivot.rotation.y=0;
    }
  },
  // Torreta independent del xassís; interpolació amb inèrcia i camí angular més curt.
  aimTurret(THREE,model,worldDirection,dt){
    const rig=model?.userData,pivot=rig?.turretPivot,pitch=rig?.turretPitch;
    if(!pivot||!pitch||!worldDirection||worldDirection.lengthSq()<.00001)return false;
    model.updateWorldMatrix(true,false);
    const local=worldDirection.clone().normalize().applyQuaternion(
      model.getWorldQuaternion(new THREE.Quaternion()).invert());
    // Un objectiu pràcticament vertical no ha de fer girar la torre 180°.
    const yaw=Math.hypot(local.x,local.z)<1e-4
            ?pivot.rotation.y:Math.atan2(-local.x,-local.z),
          elev=Math.max(-.42,Math.min(.43,Math.atan2(local.y,Math.hypot(local.x,local.z)))),
          step=Math.min(.08,Math.max(0,Number.isFinite(dt)?dt:0));
    const approach=(angle,target,key,maxSpeed,wrap)=>{
      const delta=wrap?Math.atan2(Math.sin(target-angle),Math.cos(target-angle)):target-angle;
      const desired=Math.max(-maxSpeed,Math.min(maxSpeed,delta*3.8));
      let velocity=rig[key]||0;
      velocity+=(desired-velocity)*(1-Math.exp(-8*step));
      const move=velocity*step;
      if(Math.abs(move)>=Math.abs(delta)){rig[key]=0;return angle+delta}
      rig[key]=velocity;return angle+move;
    };
    pivot.rotation.y=approach(pivot.rotation.y,yaw,'turretYawSpeed',rig.turretYawRate||1.55,true);
    pitch.rotation.x=approach(pitch.rotation.x,elev,'turretPitchSpeed',.85,false);
    const yawError=Math.atan2(Math.sin(yaw-pivot.rotation.y),Math.cos(yaw-pivot.rotation.y));
    return Math.abs(yawError)<.085&&Math.abs(elev-pitch.rotation.x)<.085;
  },
  // L'origen i l'orientació dels projectils són els del canó visible.
  turretShot(THREE,model){
    const muzzle=model?.userData?.turretMuzzle;
    if(!muzzle)return null;
    model.updateWorldMatrix(true,true);
    return {
      origin:muzzle.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3()),
      direction:new THREE.Vector3(0,0,-1)
        .applyQuaternion(muzzle.getWorldQuaternion(new THREE.Quaternion())).normalize()
    };
  },
  createFactory(THREE,{box,material,shadows}){
    const VS=this.scales,templates=new Map(),resources=window.HUNTER_RESOURCES;
    const rod=(g,a,b,r,c,profile='metal')=>{const v=new THREE.Vector3(...a),w=new THREE.Vector3(...b),delta=w.clone().sub(v),m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r,r,delta.length(),8),material(c,profile));m.position.copy(v.add(w).multiplyScalar(.5));m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),delta.normalize());g.add(m);return m};
    const round=(g,r,h,c,x,y,z,axis='y',profile='metal')=>{const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r,r,h,12),material(c,profile));m.position.set(x,y,z);if(axis==='x')m.rotation.z=Math.PI/2;if(axis==='z')m.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;g.add(m);return m};
    const roundedPrism=(g,w,h,d,r,c,x,y,z,profile='paint')=>{const hw=w/2,hh=h/2,rr=Math.min(r,hw-.02,hh-.02),s=new THREE.Shape();s.moveTo(-hw+rr,-hh);s.lineTo(hw-rr,-hh);s.quadraticCurveTo(hw,-hh,hw,-hh+rr);s.lineTo(hw,hh-rr);s.quadraticCurveTo(hw,hh,hw-rr,hh);s.lineTo(-hw+rr,hh);s.quadraticCurveTo(-hw,hh,-hw,hh-rr);s.lineTo(-hw,-hh+rr);s.quadraticCurveTo(-hw,-hh,-hw+rr,-hh);s.closePath();const geo=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s,{depth:d,bevelEnabled:false,curveSegments:2});geo.translate(0,0,-d/2);const m=new THREE.Mesh(geo,material(c,profile));m.position.set(x,y,z);g.add(m);return m};
    const wheel=(g,x,y,z,r,width,spokes=false,steer=false,owner=g)=>{
      let parent=g,px=x,py=y,pz=z;
      if(steer){
        const steering=new THREE.Group();steering.position.set(x,y,z);g.add(steering);
        (g.userData.steeringPivots||(g.userData.steeringPivots=[])).push(steering);
        parent=steering;px=0;py=0;pz=0;
      }
      const p=new THREE.Group();p.position.set(px,py,pz);parent.add(p);const tire=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(r*.8,r*.2,6,12),material(0x20252a,'rubber'));tire.rotation.y=Math.PI/2;tire.scale.z=width/(r*.4);p.add(tire);round(p,r*.45,width*.8,0x8b9699,0,0,0,'x','metal');if(spokes)for(let a=0;a<Math.PI;a+=Math.PI/3)rod(p,[0,Math.sin(a)*r*.75,Math.cos(a)*r*.75],[0,-Math.sin(a)*r*.75,-Math.cos(a)*r*.75],.035,0xb6bdc1,'metal');p.userData.radius=r;(owner.userData.wheels||(owner.userData.wheels=[])).push(p);return p};
    return function createVehicle(t,appearance={}){
      const cacheKey=t==='camio'?'camio':t==='cotxe_civil'?'civil:'+String(appearance.color??0x4b9fd1):null;
      if(resources&&cacheKey&&templates.has(cacheKey))return resources.cloneModel(templates.get(cacheKey));
      const g=new THREE.Group();g.rotation.order='YXZ';const metal=0x3e4849,glass=0x76acba,rubber=0x252d31;
      if(t==='cotxe_civil'){
        // Model definitiu C1A aprovat a la preview: mateixos passos de roda,
        // vidres, habitacle i maleter. La geometria s'instancia per cotxe.
        const factory=window.HUNTER_CIVIL_C1A;
        if(typeof factory!=='function')throw new Error('Falta el model civil C1A');
        const car=factory(THREE,appearance.color??0x4b9fd1);
        g.add(car);
        g.userData.wheels=car.userData.wheels;
        g.userData.steeringPivots=car.userData.steeringPivots;
        // Distància rodada = velocitat × dt / radi real escalat.
        // Evitam que el pneumàtic sembli relliscar per un radi genèric.
        for(const wheel of g.userData.wheels)
          wheel.userData.radius*=VS.cotxe_civil;
        g.userData.civilianModel='C1A';
        g.userData.civilianColor=appearance.color??0x4b9fd1;
        // Fusionam només peces estàtiques, i no els vidres transparents:
        // això conserva l'ordre de dibuix i permet moure les quatre rodes.
        const batches=new Map();
        for(const mesh of car.children.filter(o=>o.isMesh&&!o.material.transparent)){
          mesh.updateMatrix();
          const transformed=mesh.geometry.clone();
          transformed.applyMatrix4(mesh.matrix);
          if(!transformed.getAttribute('normal'))transformed.computeVertexNormals();
          const flat=transformed.index?transformed.toNonIndexed():transformed;
          const batch=batches.get(mesh.material)||{pos:[],norm:[],material:mesh.material};
          const vertices=flat.getAttribute('position'),normals=flat.getAttribute('normal');
          for(let i=0;i<vertices.count;i++){
            batch.pos.push(vertices.getX(i),vertices.getY(i),vertices.getZ(i));
            batch.norm.push(normals.getX(i),normals.getY(i),normals.getZ(i));
          }
          batches.set(mesh.material,batch);
          car.remove(mesh);
          mesh.geometry.dispose();transformed.dispose();
          if(flat!==transformed)flat.dispose();
        }
        let count=0;
        for(const b of batches.values()){
          const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
          geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.pos,3));
          geo.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(b.norm,3));
          const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,b.material);
          mesh.name='civil-c1a-batch-'+count++;
          car.add(mesh);
        }
        g.userData.staticBatches=count;
      }
      if(t==='cotxe'&&window.HUNTER_HUMVEE_D31?.create){
        // Model definitiu Humvee D3.1, aprovat amb les quatre portes planes.
        // La seva escala interna = 1.75 / VS.cotxe; la fàbrica general
        // aplica VS.cotxe una sola vegada al final.
        const humvee=window.HUNTER_HUMVEE_D31.create();
        resources?.retainModel(humvee);
        g.add(humvee);
        g.userData.wheels=humvee.userData.wheels;
        g.userData.steeringPivots=humvee.userData.steeringPivots;
        g.userData.humveeModel='D3.1';
        g.userData.humveeScale=window.HUNTER_HUMVEE_D31.scale;
      }
      if(t==='cotxe'&&!window.HUNTER_HUMVEE_D31){const col=0xa35b38,trim=0x302f2d;box(g,3,1,5.6,col,0,1.15,0,'paint');box(g,2.92,.42,2.1,col,0,1.82,-1.72,'paint');box(g,2.62,.82,2.72,glass,0,2.04,.48,'glass');box(g,2.88,.18,2.95,col,0,2.52,.48,'paint');box(g,2.45,.1,1.1,0x7d432f,0,2.65,.5,'paint');for(const x of[-1.34,1.34]){box(g,.13,.28,2.9,col,x,1.7,.5,'paint');box(g,.15,.82,.14,col,x,2.04,-.82,'paint');box(g,.15,.82,.14,col,x,2.04,1.82,'paint');box(g,.18,.82,.15,col,x,2.04,.5,'paint');for(const z of[-1.85,1.85])wheel(g,x*1.16,.72,z,.72,.45,false,z<0);box(g,.35,.18,.4,metal,x*1.17,2.08,-.85,'metal')}for(const z of[-2.95,2.95])box(g,3.25,.3,.3,metal,0,.94,z,'metal');box(g,1.6,.45,.08,rubber,0,1.4,-2.84,'rubber');box(g,2.5,.14,.12,trim,0,1.12,-2.88,'rubber');for(const x of[-1.08,1.08]){box(g,.5,.34,.1,0xffedb2,x,1.43,-2.85,'paint');box(g,.38,.24,.1,0x9c2825,x,1.38,2.84,'paint')}for(const x of[-.72,.72])box(g,.5,.1,.16,0xd8d7c9,x,1.03,-2.9,'metal');const spare=wheel(g,0,1.5,3,.65,.45);spare.rotation.y=Math.PI/2;(g.userData.wheels||[]).pop()}
      if(t==='cotxe'&&!window.HUNTER_HUMVEE_D31){
        // Reserva per si el GLB encara no s'ha pogut carregar.
        // El conductor veu el volant per darrere del parabrisa.
        const steeringWheel=new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.TorusGeometry(.27,.045,8,16),
          material(0x303735,'rubber'));
        steeringWheel.position.set(-.72,1.91,-.67);
        steeringWheel.rotation.x=-.35;g.add(steeringWheel);
        box(g,.86,.14,.85,0x424640,-.72,1.15,.42,'rubber');
        box(g,.82,.72,.13,0x424640,-.72,1.59,.85,'rubber');
      }
      if(t==='camio'){
        // A4.3: el mateix low-poly de la preview, adaptat a la
        // caixa de col·lisió física existent (3.6 × 7.8, abans de VS).
        const factory=window.HUNTER_TRUCK_CONCEPT;
        if(typeof factory!=='function')throw new Error('Falta el model A4.3');
        const truck=factory(THREE),fit=.82;
        // Les sis rodes són animades; fusionam només malles estàtiques.
        // Una malla per material evita 140+ draw calls per camió.
        const groups=new Map();
        for(const mesh of truck.children.filter(o=>o.isMesh)){
          mesh.updateMatrix();
          const geometry=mesh.geometry.clone();
          geometry.applyMatrix4(mesh.matrix);
          if(!geometry.getAttribute('normal'))geometry.computeVertexNormals();
          const flat=geometry.index?geometry.toNonIndexed():geometry;
          const grp=groups.get(mesh.material)||{pos:[],norm:[],material:mesh.material};
          const positions=flat.getAttribute('position'),normals=flat.getAttribute('normal');
          for(let i=0;i<positions.count;i++){
            grp.pos.push(positions.getX(i),positions.getY(i),positions.getZ(i));
            grp.norm.push(normals.getX(i),normals.getY(i),normals.getZ(i));
          }
          groups.set(mesh.material,grp);
          truck.remove(mesh);
          mesh.geometry.dispose();geometry.dispose();
          if(flat!==geometry)flat.dispose();
        }
        let batches=0;
        for(const grp of groups.values()){
          const geometry=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
          geometry.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(grp.pos,3));
          geometry.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(grp.norm,3));
          const merged=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,grp.material);
          merged.name='truck-static-batch-'+batches++;
          truck.add(merged);
        }
        truck.scale.setScalar(fit);
        g.add(truck);
        g.userData.wheels=truck.userData.wheels||[];
        g.userData.steeringPivots=truck.userData.steeringPivots||[];
        for(const w of g.userData.wheels)w.userData.radius=.80*fit*VS.camio;
        g.userData.truckModel='A4.3';
        g.userData.truckStaticBatches=batches;
        g.userData.truckVisualFit=fit;
      }
      if(t==='bici'||t==='moto'){
        const moto=t==='moto',r=moto?.65:.62,L=moto?1.5:1.22,col=moto?0xbc743d:(appearance.color??0x3f9b9d);
        // La forquilla i el manillar pivoten junts amb la roda de davant.
        // Centre de gir al coll de direcció (1.65, -0.95).
        const steering=new THREE.Group();steering.position.set(0,1.65,-.95);g.add(steering);
        (g.userData.steeringPivots||(g.userData.steeringPivots=[])).push(steering);
        wheel(steering,0,r-1.65,-L+.95,r,moto?.35:.15,true,false,g);
        wheel(g,0,r,L,r,moto?.35:.15,true);
        for(const x of[-.15,.15]){
          rod(g,[x,r,L],[x,1.45,.3],.07,col,'paint');
          rod(g,[x,r,L],[x,.72,0],.07,col,'paint');
          rod(g,[x,.72,0],[x,1.45,.3],.07,col,'paint');
          rod(g,[x,1.45,.3],[x,1.6,-.9],.07,col,'paint');
          rod(g,[x,.72,0],[x,1.6,-.9],.07,col,'paint');
          rod(steering,[x,r-1.65,-L+.95],[x,1.95-1.65,0],.06,metal);
        }
        box(g,.55,.16,.75,rubber,0,1.55,.4,'rubber');
        rod(steering,[-.55,1.98-1.65,-.05],[.55,1.98-1.65,-.05],.07,metal);
        round(g,.18,.65,metal,0,.75,0,'x');
        if(moto){
          box(g,.72,.52,1.05,col,0,1.3,-.28,'paint');
          box(g,.56,.64,.66,metal,0,.87,0,'metal');
          box(g,.5,.18,.82,0x2e3133,0,1.6,.52,'rubber');
          round(steering,.2,.18,0xffe4ad,0,.03,-.35,'z','paint');
          box(g,.12,.22,.12,0xc52f24,-.36,1.18,1.35,'paint');
          box(g,.12,.22,.12,0xc52f24,.36,1.18,1.35,'paint');
          rod(g,[.4,.6,.2],[.4,.6,1.3],.12,metal);
          rod(g,[-.4,.6,.2],[-.4,.6,1.3],.12,metal);
        }else{
          for(const x of[-.4,.4])box(g,.22,.1,.35,rubber,x,.73,0,'rubber');
          box(g,.5,.1,.65,0x252a2c,0,1.58,.42,'rubber');
          round(steering,.09,.5,0xcfd5d6,0,.25,-.05,'x','metal');
        }
      }
      if(t==='tanqueta'){
        for(const x of[-1.42,1.42])for(const z of[-1.55,0,1.55])
          wheel(g,x,.68,z,.58,.34,false,z<0);
        box(g,2.75,.42,4.6,0x596343,0,.88,0,'paint');
        box(g,2.55,1.02,3.8,0x667348,0,1.42,.05,'paint');
        const nose=box(g,2.48,.72,1.15,0x727c50,0,1.62,-1.65,'paint');
        nose.rotation.x=-.18;
        for(const x of[-1.05,1.05])box(g,.32,.18,.18,0xffe0a0,x,1.48,-2.24,'paint');
        const turret=new THREE.Group();turret.position.set(0,2.22,-.15);g.add(turret);
        // La base rectangular queda fixa al xassís; només gira la corona cilíndrica.
        box(g,2.08,.58,1.7,0x727c50,0,2.02,-.15,'paint');
        round(turret,.68,.32,0x586543,0,.18,0,'y','paint');
        const elev=new THREE.Group();elev.position.set(0,.26,-.5);turret.add(elev);
        rod(elev,[0,0,0],[0,0,-2.4],.1,metal);
        box(elev,.3,.24,.5,metal,0,0,-2.27,'metal');
        const muzzle=new THREE.Object3D();muzzle.position.set(0,0,-2.4);elev.add(muzzle);
        g.userData.turretPivot=turret;g.userData.turretPitch=elev;
        g.userData.turretMuzzle=muzzle;g.userData.turretYawRate=2.05;
      }
      if(t==='tanc'){
        const trackSide=x=>{
          const side=Math.sign(x),outer=x+side*.02,trackMetal=0x53564d,cy=.78,r=.66,front=-2.62,rear=2.62,straight=rear-front,perimeter=2*straight+2*Math.PI*r;
          box(g,1.05,1.16,5.25,rubber,outer,cy,0,'rubber');
          round(g,r,1.04,rubber,outer,cy,front,'x','rubber');
          round(g,r,1.04,rubber,outer,cy,rear,'x','rubber');
          for(const z of[-2.35,-1.18,0,1.18,2.35]){
            const w=wheel(g,x+side*.52,.76,z,.55,.16);
            w.userData.trackSide=side;
          }
          const links=[],count=Math.round(perimeter/.38);
          for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
            const link=box(g,1.17,.11,.28,trackMetal,outer,cy,0,'metal');
            link.userData.trackOffset=i*perimeter/count;
            links.push(link);
          }
          (g.userData.tracks||(g.userData.tracks=[])).push({side,links,phase:0,cy,r,front,rear,straight,perimeter,x:outer});
        };
        [-2.1,2.1].forEach(trackSide);
        box(g,3.75,1.15,5.9,0x667348,0,1.5,0,'paint');
        const front=box(g,3.65,.72,1.55,0x727c50,0,1.95,-2.05,'paint');front.rotation.x=-.28;
        for(const x of[-1.45,1.45])box(g,.22,.52,4.9,0x56623f,x,1.88,.15,'paint');
        const turret=new THREE.Group();turret.position.set(0,2.54,.1);g.add(turret);
        round(turret,1.62,.82,0x78845b,0,0,0,'y','paint');
        box(turret,2.2,.26,1.65,0x6d7950,0,.38,0,'paint');
        round(turret,.62,.2,metal,.45,.54,.3);
        rod(turret,[-1,.16,.9],[-1,2.66,.9],.025,metal);
        const elev=new THREE.Group();elev.position.set(0,.08,-1.1);turret.add(elev);
        rod(elev,[0,0,0],[0,0,-4.35],.2,metal);
        box(elev,.66,.4,.68,metal,0,0,-4.08,'metal');

        detail.setIndex([0,1,2,3,4,5]);detail.computeVertexNormals();
        const trim=material(sailAccent,'paint');trim.side=THREE.DoubleSide;
        const contrast=new THREE.Mesh(detail,trim);
        contrast.name='windsurf-sail-panels';
        rig.add(contrast);
        for(const [a,b] of [
          [[0,.55,0],[-2.92,1.54,0]],
          [[-2.92,1.54,0],[-2.84,3.12,0]],
          [[-2.84,3.12,0],[-2.19,5.30,0]],
          [[-2.19,5.30,0],[-1.12,7.34,0]],
          [[-1.12,7.34,0],[0,8.18,0]]
        ])rod(rig,a,b,.031,metal);
        // Botavara sobre la cara del rider (+Z). Les dues mans segueixen
        // punts diferents del travesser; la dreta es pot alliberar per disparar.
        const boomStart=new THREE.Vector3(0,2.66,.57),
              boomEnd=new THREE.Vector3(-1.85,2.45,.57);
        rod(rig,boomStart.toArray(),boomEnd.toArray(),.055,metal);
        rod(rig,[0,2.66,0],boomStart.toArray(),.044,metal);
        g.userData.windsurfRig=rig;
        // Anatomia: índex 0 = mà esquerra (més exterior);
        // índex 1 = dreta, que empunya la pistola quan dispara.
        g.userData.windsurfGrips=[.37,.12].map(k=>
          boomStart.clone().lerp(boomEnd,k));
        g.userData.windsurfLay=null;
        rig.rotation.x=-.14;
        rig.rotation.z=.055;
      }
      if(t==='ferry'){
        const hullCol=0x4e6570,deckCol=0x8f9692,edge=0xd7d2bd,cabin=0xe7e3d5;
        box(g,32,2.25,55,hullCol,0,.7,0,'paint');
        box(g,30.4,.3,51.6,deckCol,0,2.12,0,'metal');
        for(const x of[-15.05,15.05])box(g,.28,1.05,51.4,edge,x,2.58,0,'metal');
        // Les rampes conserven exactament les mides originals.
        const frontRamp=box(g,13.6,.3,6.2,deckCol,0,1.35,-28.4,'metal');frontRamp.rotation.x=-.22;
        const rearRamp=box(g,13.6,.3,6.2,deckCol,0,1.35,28.4,'metal');rearRamp.rotation.x=.22;
        for(const x of[-6.55,6.55]){rod(g,[x,2.3,-25.6],[x,.65,-31.2],.12,edge);rod(g,[x,2.3,25.6],[x,.65,31.2],.12,edge)}
        box(g,3.35,3.7,7.6,cabin,11.5,4.05,1.8,'paint');
        box(g,3.05,1.05,7.1,glass,11.5,4.62,1.8,'glass');
        box(g,3.65,.28,8.05,hullCol,11.5,6.02,1.8,'metal');
        for(const z of[-1.05,1.15,3.35])box(g,.16,1.05,.18,hullCol,9.87,4.62,z,'metal');
        rod(g,[11.5,6.15,3.8],[11.5,9.4,3.8],.11,metal);box(g,1.25,.18,.18,0x30383a,11.5,9.42,3.8,'metal');
        for(const x of[-14.3,14.3])for(const z of[-21,-14,-7,0,7,14,21])round(g,.18,.28,0x252d31,x,1.45,z,'z','rubber');
        for(const z of[-24.5,24.5])for(const x of[-10,-5,0,5,10])box(g,2.2,.08,.28,0xf1e9c5,x,2.32,z,'paint');
        g.userData.ferryDeck=true;
      }
      if(t==='hover'){box(g,5,.85,8,rubber,0,.55,0,'rubber');for(const x of[-2.35,2.35])for(let z=-3.5;z<4;z+=.65)box(g,.2,.7,.48,0x394145,x,.5,z,'rubber');box(g,4.45,.85,6.7,0xcf9e4f,0,1.38,-.2,'paint');box(g,2.75,1.12,2.9,glass,0,2.2,-.92,'glass');box(g,2.98,.22,3.2,0xcda75f,0,2.82,-.92,'paint');for(const x of[-2.05,2.05])box(g,.18,.3,6.7,0xa97835,x,1.25,-.2,'paint');for(const x of[-1.1,1.1])box(g,.42,.22,.16,0xffe09a,x,1.45,-3.55,'paint');const duct=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.55,.2,8,20),material(metal,'metal'));duct.position.set(0,2.9,3);g.add(duct);const fan=new THREE.Group();fan.position.copy(duct.position);for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const blade=box(fan,.2,2.8,.12,rubber,0,0,0,'rubber');blade.rotation.z=i*Math.PI/4}g.add(fan);g.userData.fan=fan;round(g,.28,.3,0x7b8588,0,2.9,3,'z','metal');for(const x of[-1.7,1.7]){box(g,.15,2.05,1,0xbe8c43,x,2.68,3.5,'paint');rod(g,[x,1.7,2.65],[x,3.65,3.2],.07,metal)}box(g,1.4,.18,.8,0x5b4939,0,1.88,1.45,'paint')}
      if(t==='heli'||t==='heli_combat'){
        const combat=t==='heli_combat',bodyCol=combat?0x59634f:0x647768;
        if(!combat){
          // Huey 3B-4: la secció central és un PASSADÍS OBERT de banda a
          // banda, no un prisma massís amagat rere els marcs de les portes.
          // Frontal i cua conserven el gruix; al mig, només sòl i sostre.
          const doorFront=-.76,doorRear=1.76,frontEnd=-1.79,rearEnd=2.39;
          roundedPrism(g,2.7,1.74,doorFront-frontEnd,.20,bodyCol,0,2.08,(frontEnd+doorFront)/2,'paint');
          roundedPrism(g,2.7,1.74,rearEnd-doorRear,.16,bodyCol,0,2.08,(doorRear+rearEnd)/2,'paint');
          roundedPrism(g,2.7,.16,doorRear-doorFront,.06,bodyCol,0,1.28,(doorFront+doorRear)/2,'paint');
          roundedPrism(g,2.7,.20,doorRear-doorFront,.06,bodyCol,0,2.88,(doorFront+doorRear)/2,'paint');
          const belly=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,10,6),material(bodyCol,'paint'));belly.scale.set(1.24,.24,1.92);belly.position.set(0,1.39,.34);g.add(belly);
          const nose=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,10,6),material(glass,'glass'));nose.scale.set(1.28,.9,1.02);nose.position.set(0,2.17,-2.35);g.add(nose);
          roundedPrism(g,2.38,.32,2.12,.13,bodyCol,0,2.91,.04,'paint');
          // Grans obertures laterals de transport.
          const sideX=1.36;
          for(const side of[-1,1]){
            box(g,.1,1.18,.36,bodyCol,side*sideX,2.0,-.76,'paint');
            box(g,.1,1.18,.36,bodyCol,side*sideX,2.0,1.76,'paint');
            box(g,.1,.14,2.05,0x343b35,side*(sideX+.01),1.43,.5,'metal');
            rod(g,[side*sideX,2.58,-.58],[side*sideX,2.58,1.58],.052,bodyCol,'paint');
            // Variant 4: petit carenat arrodonit en lloc dels antics discs laterals.
            const pod=roundedPrism(g,.28,.58,.82,.12,bodyCol,side*1.323,1.86,-2.37,'paint');pod.rotation.z=side*.08;
            box(g,.08,.32,.46,0x343b35,side*1.364,1.88,-2.38,'metal');
          }
          // Bancs interiors visibles a través de les portes.
          for(const x of[-.82,.82])box(g,.4,.46,2.1,0x2d302c,x,1.55,.55,'paint');
          // Boom de cua afinat i estabilitzador.
          {const startZ=2,endZ=7.48,y0=2.58,y1=2.98,L=Math.hypot(endZ-startZ,y1-y0),boom=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.176,.42,L,6),material(bodyCol,'paint'));boom.position.set(0,(y0+y1)/2,(startZ+endZ)/2);boom.rotation.x=Math.PI/2-Math.atan2(y1-y0,endZ-startZ);g.add(boom)}
          box(g,.12,1.35,.88,bodyCol,0,3.34,7.36,'paint');box(g,2.25,.1,.58,bodyCol,0,2.9,6.43,'paint');
          // Patins del model 3B.
          for(const x of[-1.458,1.458]){rod(g,[x,.48,-2.12],[x,.48,2.3],.075,metal);rod(g,[x*.45,1.15,-1.05],[x,.48,-1.05],.07,metal);rod(g,[x*.45,1.15,1.0],[x,.48,1.0],.07,metal)}
          roundedPrism(g,1.3,.62,1.8,.17,0x505b49,0,3.12,.82,'paint');
          rod(g,[.494,3.15,1.34],[.845,3.2,1.78],.11,0x343b35,'metal');
        }else{
          // Combat Compacte B3 · Apache: cabines igualades, fuselatge compacte i unió diagonal.
          const fus=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,10,6),material(bodyCol,'paint'));fus.scale.set(.86,.86,2.51);fus.position.set(0,2.08,.2);g.add(fus);
          roundedPrism(g,1.38,.48,1.9,.15,0x4f5949,0,2.68,-.12,'paint');

          // Dues cabines de mida equivalent, més angulars, inspirades en l'Apache.
          const front=roundedPrism(g,1.31,.78,.98,.025,glass,0,2.13,-2.45,'glass');front.rotation.x=-.11;
          const rear=roundedPrism(g,1.31,.78,.98,.025,glass,0,2.46,-1.34,'glass');rear.rotation.x=.06;
          box(g,1.45,.2,.3,bodyCol,0,1.84,-2.93,'paint');
          const bridge=box(g,1.38,.56,.76,bodyCol,0,2.5,-1.87,'paint');bridge.rotation.x=-.5;
          box(g,1.31,.26,.62,bodyCol,0,2.83,-.68,'paint');

          // Aletes curtes i barquilles grans.
          for(const x of[-1.57,1.57]){
            const side=Math.sign(x);
            rod(g,[side*.58,2.0,-.08],[x,1.8,.08],.085,metal);
            box(g,.18,.13,1.9,0x4c5749,x,1.79,.18,'paint');
            round(g,.26,1.9,0x39423a,x,1.68,.18,'z','metal');
            box(g,.34,.18,.45,0x303638,x,1.68,-.86,'metal');
          }

          // Canó de morro.
          rod(g,[0,1.72,-2.85],[0,1.72,-4.0],.11,metal);box(g,.3,.26,.52,0x343b35,0,1.72,-3.92,'metal');

          // Patins connectats directament al fuselatge.
          for(const x of[-1.17,1.17]){
            const side=Math.sign(x);
            rod(g,[x,.48,-1.72],[x,.48,1.42],.075,metal);
            rod(g,[side*.55,1.85,-1.0],[x,.48,-1.0],.075,metal);
            rod(g,[side*.62,1.88,.15],[x,.48,.15],.075,metal);
            rod(g,[side*.58,1.82,.95],[x,.48,.95],.075,metal);
          }

          // Boom de cua afinat i estabilitzador del B3.
          {const startZ=.95,endZ=6.99,y0=2.42,y1=2.95,L=Math.hypot(endZ-startZ,y1-y0),boom=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.147,.35,L,6),material(bodyCol,'paint'));boom.position.set(0,(y0+y1)/2,(startZ+endZ)/2);boom.rotation.x=Math.PI/2-Math.atan2(y1-y0,endZ-startZ);g.add(boom)}
          box(g,.12,1.35,.88,bodyCol,0,3.34,6.87,'paint');
          box(g,2.25,.1,.58,bodyCol,0,2.9,5.94,'paint');
        }
        const rotorY=combat?3.22:3.82,mastBaseY=combat?2.94:3.02;rod(g,[0,mastBaseY,0],[0,rotorY,0],.14,metal);round(g,.3,.2,metal,0,rotorY,0,'y','metal');const rotor=new THREE.Group();rotor.position.set(0,rotorY,0);// Una sola pala contínua de punta a punta = dues aspes oposades al combat. El Huey manté quatre aspes.
        for(const a of(combat?[0]:[0,Math.PI/2])){const blade=box(rotor,combat?13.5:14.8,.1,.36,rubber,0,0,0,'rubber');blade.rotation.y=a}g.add(rotor);g.userData.rotor=rotor;
        const tail=new THREE.Group();tail.position.set(.38,3.45,combat?7:7.38);box(tail,.1,1.9,.16,rubber,0,0,0,'rubber');box(tail,.1,.16,1.9,rubber,0,0,0,'rubber');g.add(tail);g.userData.tailRotor=tail;
      }
      if(t==='bici'){const crank=new THREE.Group();crank.position.set(0,.75,0);for(const side of[-1,1]){rod(crank,[side*.3,0,0],[side*.3,0,side*.28],.045,metal);box(crank,.26,.08,.18,rubber,side*.4,0,side*.28,'rubber')}g.add(crank);g.userData.crank=crank}
      // La coordenada Y de l'origen no és l'altura dels patins.
      // Les dues barres inferiors estan centrades a y=.48 i tenen radi .075.
      // Guardam el contacte inferior JA escalat per a la física d'aterratge.
      if(t==='heli'||t==='heli_combat'){
        g.userData.skidContactHeight=(.48-.075)*VS[t];
        g.userData.rotorContactHeight=((t==='heli_combat'?3.22:3.82)+.05)*VS[t];
      }
      g.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&!o.userData.waterMask){o.castShadow=shadows;o.receiveShadow=shadows}});
      g.scale.setScalar(VS[t]);
      if(resources&&cacheKey){
        resources.retainModel(g);templates.set(cacheKey,g);
        return resources.cloneModel(g);
      }
      return g;
    };
  }
});


;

 player:20,medkit:8,
 people:Object.freeze({soldier:4,elite:8,general:8}),
 weapons:Object.freeze({knife:2,pistol:2,rifle:2,eliteRifle:2,sniper:10,tankette:2,attackCannon:2,bazooka:8,grenade:10,c4:20,tank:12,heliMissile:12,boatRocket:12,towerLight:2,towerHeavy:12}),
 vehicles:Object.freeze({bici:1,moto:2,cotxe:5,cotxe_civil:4,camio:10,tanqueta:12,tanc:20,windsurf:1,barca_rems:2,moto_aquatica:3,llanxa:5,llanxa_coets:10,ferry:15,hover:6,heli:10,heli_combat:15})

// Els perfils comparteixen interfície, però terra, aigua i aire tenen inèrcies diferents.
window.HUNTER_VEHICLE_DYNAMICS=Object.freeze({
  types:Object.freeze({
    llanxa:Object.freeze({n:'Llanxa',m:'w',a:35,dr:.8,tu:1.4,cd:30,ch:12,response:2.6,steerResponse:2.8,yawResponse:2.4,maxF:35,maxR:9,waterDrift:.14,waterSteerMin:.22,life:window.HUNTER_COMBAT_BALANCE.vehicles.llanxa}),

    barca_rems:Object.freeze({n:'Barca de rems',m:'w',a:20,dr:.82,tu:1.6,cd:25,ch:10,response:3.4,steerResponse:4,yawResponse:3.2,maxF:17,maxR:5,waterDrift:.2,waterSteerMin:.18,life:window.HUNTER_COMBAT_BALANCE.vehicles.barca_rems}),
    windsurf:Object.freeze({n:'Windsurf',m:'w',a:18,dr:.75,tu:2.1,cd:16,ch:5,response:4.5,steerResponse:5.5,yawResponse:4.8,maxF:22,maxR:5,waterDrift:.42,waterSteerMin:.3,life:window.HUNTER_COMBAT_BALANCE.vehicles.windsurf}),
    camio:Object.freeze({n:'Camió militar',m:'l',a:24,dr:.92,tu:1.35,cd:27,ch:9,response:3.1,steerResponse:3.4,yawResponse:3.2,maxF:29,maxR:10,landGrip:.82,steerFade:.5,mass:2.2,life:window.HUNTER_COMBAT_BALANCE.vehicles.camio}),
    tanqueta:Object.freeze({n:'Tanqueta',m:'l',a:20,dr:.92,tu:1.45,cd:25,ch:10,response:2.8,steerResponse:3.1,yawResponse:2.9,maxF:24,maxR:9,landGrip:.88,steerFade:.38,mass:3.2,life:window.HUNTER_COMBAT_BALANCE.vehicles.tanqueta}),
    llanxa_coets:Object.freeze({n:'Llanxa llançacoets',m:'w',a:27,dr:.82,tu:1.35,cd:31,ch:12,response:2.5,steerResponse:2.7,yawResponse:2.2,maxF:29,maxR:8,waterDrift:.11,waterSteerMin:.2,life:window.HUNTER_COMBAT_BALANCE.vehicles.llanxa_coets}),
    tanc:Object.freeze({n:'Tanc',m:'l',a:16,dr:.9,tu:1.1,cd:26,ch:10,response:2.2,steerResponse:2.4,yawResponse:2.4,maxF:21,maxR:8,landGrip:.96,steerFade:.3,mass:5,life:window.HUNTER_COMBAT_BALANCE.vehicles.tanc}),
    heli:Object.freeze({n:'Helicòpter',m:'a',a:38,dr:.5,tu:1.6,cd:34,ch:12,response:2.8,steerResponse:3.2,yawResponse:2.3,maxF:50,maxR:17,strafeMax:17,climb:24,liftResponse:2.8,bank:.34,pitch:.22,mass:2.5,life:window.HUNTER_COMBAT_BALANCE.vehicles.heli}),
    heli_combat:Object.freeze({n:'Helicòpter de combat',m:'a',a:47,dr:.48,tu:2.25,cd:36,ch:13,response:5,steerResponse:6,yawResponse:5.1,maxF:60,maxR:21,strafeMax:24,climb:30,liftResponse:4.3,bank:.45,pitch:.29,mass:2.8,life:window.HUNTER_COMBAT_BALANCE.vehicles.heli_combat})
  }),
  // Shore contact uses actual water height and the vehicle's hull footprint.
  // No shoreline teleportation or universal -1.2 m collision cutoff.
  shore:Object.freeze({
    land:Object.freeze({
      bici:{wade:.1,stall:.65,delay:.1,sinkRate:2.5},
      moto:{wade:.25,stall:1.0,delay:.35,sinkRate:1.8},
      cotxe:{wade:.4,stall:1.65,delay:1.25,sinkRate:1.1},
      cotxe_civil:{wade:.4,stall:1.55,delay:1.1,sinkRate:1.2},
      camio:{wade:.8,stall:2.35,delay:.75,sinkRate:1.4},
      tanqueta:{wade:1.2,stall:2.9,delay:.4,sinkRate:1.3},
      tanc:{wade:1.4,stall:3.4,delay:.35,sinkRate:1.1}
    }),
    draft:Object.freeze({windsurf:.12,barca_rems:.4,moto_aquatica:.26,llanxa:1.05,llanxa_coets:1.2,ferry:2.15}),
    beachLimit:Object.freeze({windsurf:-.4,barca_rems:.05,moto_aquatica:-.65,llanxa:.08,llanxa_coets:.1,ferry:.25}),
    depth(x,z,terrainAt,waterAt){return waterAt(x,z)-terrainAt(x,z)},
    clearance(v,x,z,box,terrainAt,waterAt){
      // A hull grounds at the bow or flank before its centre reaches land.
      // Use smaller extremities for ferry ramps, so terminal docking remains possible.
      const s=Math.sin(v.hd||0),c=Math.cos(v.hd||0),front=Math.min(box.d*.38,box.d/2-0.1),
        side=Math.min(box.w*.31,box.w/2-.05),sample=[[0,0],[0,-front],[0,front*.75],[-side,0],[side,0]];
      let min=Infinity;
      for(const [lx,lz] of sample){
        const px=x+lx*c+lz*s,pz=z-lx*s+lz*c;
        min=Math.min(min,this.depth(px,pz,terrainAt,waterAt));
      }
      return min;
    },
    wetLand(v,depth,dt){
      const p=this.land[v.t],state=v.waterIngress||(v.waterIngress={dead:false,elapsed:0,sink:0,buoyancy:0});
      if(!p)return {engine:1,drag:0,wet:0,disabled:false};
      const wet=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(depth-p.wade)/(p.stall-p.wade)));
      if(depth>=p.stall)state.dead=true;
      if(state.dead){
        state.elapsed+=Math.max(0,dt);
        state.sink=Math.max(0,(state.elapsed-p.delay)*p.sinkRate);
      }else{
        state.elapsed=0;
        state.buoyancy=Math.max(0,state.buoyancy-Math.max(0,dt)*.85);
      }
      if(depth>p.wade){
        state.buoyancy=Math.min(1,state.buoyancy+Math.max(0,dt)*.75);
      }
      if(state.dead&&state.elapsed>=p.delay+3.5)v.sunk=true;
      return {engine:state.dead?0:1-wet*.84,
        drag:state.dead?1.4:wet*(.8+wet*.6),
        wet,disabled:state.dead};
    },
    boatContact(v,previous,next,dt){
      const draft=this.draft[v.t]??.8,limit=this.beachLimit[v.t]??.05,
        shallow=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(draft-next)/Math.max(.3,draft-limit)));
      const approaching=next<previous-.0005,
        blocked=next<limit&&approaching,
        grounded=next<draft;
      v.grounded=grounded;
      return {draft,limit,shallow,grounded,blocked,
        drag:shallow*(v.t==='moto_aquatica'?3.2:v.t==='windsurf'?2.5:2.1),
        power:1-shallow*.93};
    }
  }),
  smooth(current,target,response,dt){return current+(target-current)*(1-Math.exp(-response*dt))},
  inputs(v,forward,turn,dt){
    const c=this.types[v.t];
    v.driveInput=this.smooth(v.driveInput||0,forward,c.response,dt);
    v.steerInput=this.smooth(v.steerInput||0,turn,c.steerResponse,dt);
    if(Math.abs(forward)<.015&&Math.abs(v.driveInput)<.015)v.driveInput=0;
    if(Math.abs(turn)<.015&&Math.abs(v.steerInput)<.015)v.steerInput=0;
    return {forward:v.driveInput,turn:v.steerInput};
  }
});

;
// END src/vehicle-dynamics.js
